extras: Runs entirely offline and is private by design.
intentEvidence: I built Linkosaurus because I wanted linking to disappear as a task
motivation: I built Linkosaurus because I wanted linking to disappear as a task — in a good vault the connections are the whole point, and stopping to type brackets pulls you out of writing every single time.
problem: Manually typing wikilinks and managing connections disrupts the writing flow and adds unnecessary friction to note creation.
summary: Linkosaurus automatically converts keywords, URLs, and email addresses into functional Obsidian wikilinks as the user types, reducing manual linking effort.
